name: continuous-paper-architecture-v1
title: Continuous paper architecture v1
purpose: Ordered specification of the continuous capture-to-paper lifecycle and its fail-closed conditions. This document is a specification only, not an implemented service, not a broker or live-trading path, and not a production-readiness claim.

specification_only.statement: SPECIFICATION_ONLY_NOT_AN_IMPLEMENTED_SERVICE. No stage in this document is executed, registered or qualified by publishing this specification.

no_broker_writes.statement: NO_BROKER_WRITES. This architecture must never place, amend or cancel an order at a broker, venue or live adapter, and must never contact a provider, collect market data or authorize an entitlement.

fail_closed_conditions.name: stale data
fail_closed_conditions.trigger: input is older than the declared freshness boundary or its lineage is missing

fail_closed_conditions.name: stale ownership
fail_closed_conditions.trigger: writer epoch, fencing token or ownership evidence is absent or superseded

fail_closed_conditions.name: unknown reconciliation
fail_closed_conditions.trigger: reconciliation outcome is unknown, partial or unresolved

fail_closed_conditions.name: risk limit change
fail_closed_conditions.trigger: limits changed after intent approval or their digest is unavailable

fail_closed_conditions.name: duplicate events
fail_closed_conditions.trigger: identity or sequence already applied at the same durable transition

fail_closed_conditions.name: partial fills
fail_closed_conditions.trigger: a fill is incomplete or cannot be bound to one order lifecycle

fail_closed_conditions.name: cancel/fill races
fail_closed_conditions.trigger: cancel and fill order cannot be totally ordered by durable sequence

fail_closed_conditions.name: corrections/busts
fail_closed_conditions.trigger: a correction or bust is not fully applied and reconciled before the next transition

fail_closed_conditions.name: restart at every durable transition
fail_closed_conditions.trigger: any durable transition lacks a restart boundary and recovery checkpoint

negative_cases.case: write with stale ownership or fencing
replay a duplicate event at a transition
